name: (ADFS) Deduplication
description: Content-hash (SHA-256) file deduplication, perceptual image similarity (pHash/dHash) and duplicate-file upload alerts for managed files. A thin routing-only sub-module whose controllers and forms live in the parent Advanced Filesystem namespace.
project_description: The Deduplication sub-module of Advanced Filesystem groups the project's duplicate-file tools behind their own admin menu. It is a thin module: it ships only routing, menu links and local tasks, and every controller and form it references lives in the parent advanced_filesystem namespace. It exposes hash-based deduplication (SHA-256 grouping with a per-group preview page keyed by a 64-hex hash, a cleanup form and a cleanup report), perceptual image deduplication (pHash/dHash with a configurable Hamming-distance threshold and MIME-type scope), and duplicate-file upload alerts. All routes sit under /admin/config/media/advanced_filesystem/* and are gated behind the parent module's restricted 'administer advanced filesystem' permission.
